g.text: No word in common with the answer, so BM25 finds nothing; the dense retriever matches the meaning.
An acronym and a threshold: BM25 matches them exactly, the embedding does not. Fusion keeps the answer near
the top and the cross-encoder, reading query and passage together, puts it first.
